memory_update.text: Procurement consolidation in restaurants appears to shift value toward suppliers that combine national-account compliance, cold-chain/foodservice logistics, category expertise, and the ability to serve many franchisees or banners through fewer vendor relationships.
PFGC is a reference distributor for national-chain foodservice procurement infrastructure; use as a benchmark rather than the main underfollowed alpha candidate.
WEST and FARM are underfollowed beverage/coffee supply-chain candidates to verify for restaurant-system customer wins, approved-supplier status, capacity utilization, and customer concentration.
HFFG is a speculative micro-cap exception: niche specialty distribution may matter if ethnic restaurant groups consolidate procurement, but evidence of multi-unit chain exposure is still weak.
Need an additional search pass for public packaging, cold-storage, commissary equipment, food-safety testing, and procurement/SRM software vendors serving restaurant national accounts.

node: Multi-brand restaurant procurement consolidation and supplier relationship management
summary: This Layer 1B pass expands the universe around the procurement-consolidation node by prioritizing foodservice distribution, private-label beverage/ingredient manufacturing, direct-store-delivery coffee, and specialty ingredient distribution. Reference evidence suggests large restaurant systems are trying to unify supplier relationships, while Domino's shows how vertically coordinated procurement and distribution can become a franchise-system advantage. The underfollowed lane is therefore suppliers that can satisfy national-account compliance, multi-site logistics, food-safety requirements, and category-specific sourcing needs. This is a research universe only, not a trading recommendation.
